spokenExcerpt: Checking the service queue. The synthetic evidence shows that the automation scenario, assuming a 15% productivity gain, clears an independent, hypothetical queue in month 5 for 240,000 first-year. Two added agents clear it in month 3 for 163,200. Those model results are conditional, not predictions for the real queue, which grew 23.1% in July to September. The faster, lower cost option is staffing. I'd suggest piloting two agents for 12 weeks against a similar queue, then scale only if backlog, SLAs, and satisfaction move the right way. What time frame feels right for you?
